key.name: scene
key.description: The scene a switch passes through, or "random" for a different one each time.

key.name: duration
key.description: Milliseconds a switch to the next workspace takes; a longer jump takes up to half as long again.

key.name: step-rate
key.description: How often the scene is redrawn, as anime holds each drawing for two or three frames. 0 draws it on every frame. The workspaces always move smoothly.

key.name: focus-lines
key.description: Radial speed lines while the camera is at speed.

key.name: impact-frame
key.description: One inverted drawing of the scene as the new workspace arrives.
